name: Function calling
short_description: A capability of language models to request a specific function by name with structured inputs, letting frameworks such as Semantic Kernel run application code and return the result to the model.

evidence.quote: Then OpenAI built function calling straight into its models
Which is why everyone got excited about function calling next.
Function calling is not a boundary. It's a convenience layer.
blueprint two. Azure open AI tool calling with managed identity.
